Rita (Support): Escalating a P1 — client "AeroCart" trial is hitting embed 429s during ingestion since 10:02 UTC, breaking onboarding checks. Demo scheduled 16:00 local.
Sam (CSM): Ack. How widespread?
Rita (Support): Only their tenant, appears to be bursty writes from importer job. Sample log: 
`2026-03-23T10:01:58Z ERROR ingest status=429 tenant=aerocart reason=burst_rate quota=0`
Devon (SRE): I see a spike in concurrent prefix writes + retry storms. I can open a temporary allowance on the dedicated pool for aerocart and add a rate-limit advisory backpressure.
Luis (CS Ops): Do it — we need to remove demo risk. Also prep a short customer status and comms plan (apology, mitigation, next steps).
Sam (CSM): Please include a request that they pause automated retries for 30m; we'll offer a 10-min pre-demo check at 15:40 local.
Rita (Support): Draft status: "Hi team — we identified transient quota exhaustion causing embed failures. We've applied a temporary quota increase and are watching the service. Please pause automated retries for 30 minutes while we stabilize. We are prioritizing your onboarding and will confirm readiness by 15:40 local."
Sam (CSM): Add a line about root-cause investigation and a follow-up post-mortem.
Rita (Support): Updated message includes post-mortem promise.
Devon (SRE): Temporary +25% quota applied on pool redwood-dedicated-7 for aerocart. 429s decreased in last 90s. Creating INC-2026-033-51.
Alert Bot: Incident INC-2026-033-51 created and assigned to Devon.
Luis (CS Ops): Action items: Sam send status by 14:20 UTC, Devon run post-incident diffs and capture KV churn metrics, Rita update KB with retry guidance, CS Ops tag account as "renewal-watch" due to high ARR potential.
Sam (CSM): Sending now. Pasting for review: "Hi Marco — quick update: We've applied a temporary quota increase after transient rate-limits impacted your embed ingestion. Please pause automated retries for 30 minutes while we stabilize. We're prioritizing your onboarding and will confirm readiness for your demo at 15:40 local. We'll follow up with a post-mortem within 24 hours. — Sam, Redwood CSM"
Rita (Support): LGTM :thumbsup:
Devon (SRE): Monitoring. If errors resume, I'll escalate to runtime lead and consider traffic shaping.
Luis (CS Ops): Noted — I'll add renewal-watch to account doc and ping SE for a post-demo enablement to review ingestion best practices.
Sam (CSM): Call scheduled 15:40 local for pre-demo check. Will reopen thread if anything changes. Thanks team.
